symptoms: Wilting of terminal shoots in young eggplant vegetative stage
Boring holes in developing eggplant fruits with frass accumulation
Internal fruit rotting making produce unmarketable

treatment_protocol.organic: Pheromone traps (Leucinodes lure), release of Trichogramma chilonis parasitoid wasps
treatment_protocol.chemical: Emamectin benzoate or Chlorantraniliprole foliar spray during egg hatching window
treatment_protocol.cultural_prevention: Prompt removal and destruction of wilted shoots and infested fruits, net barrier cultivation
